source: DineIQ Analytics SRS v1.0, section 1.10 and final submission checklist

deliverables.evidence: Python model scripts, evidence, aligned retrained artifact and dependency instructions are present.

deliverables.name: Dual-pipeline model comparison report on at least 100 unseen cases
deliverables.evidence: Aligned dual-pipeline report includes 500 unseen cases, common-panel verification and agreement/disagreement fields.
deliverables.action: Agreement is technical consistency evidence, not business impact.

deliverables.name: Restaurant Intelligence report
deliverables.evidence: Restaurant intelligence report exists with menu, customer, basket, forecast, wastage, pricing, promotion, anomaly and recommendation sections.
deliverables.action: Publish/format externally if required.

deliverables.name: Functional, integration, domain and difficult-case test results
deliverables.evidence: Functional/integration/domain/difficult-case evidence includes full regression, hidden-case harness, quality tests, daily forecast tests and portable integration.
